newsitem.title: UK: Visual Action sells film unit, buys another.
newsitem.headline: Visual Action sells film unit, buys another.

text.p: Britain's Visual Action Holdings Plc said on Monday that it had sold is film services unit to Panavision Inc for 37.5 million stg and acquired MES, an exhibition services provider, for 23.1 million stg.
Visual Action's chief executive Bob Willis said the two transactions would increase the focus of the company's operations and would enhance its growth prospects.
MES, an independent exhibition service provider, had reported a turnover of 28.9 million stg for the year ended June, 1996. Its customers included Miller Freeman, EMAP and Reed.
The turnover of Visual's film services unit was 41.6 million stg in the year to December 1996.
"We plan to invest the remaining disposal proceeds in developing our activities in the corporate meetings and broadcast video markets both organically and by further acquisitions," Ellis said.
